| Q1-003 | Can a candidate family with a latent shared regressor separate a shared quantity that gates decisions from one that only constrains outcomes? | result_reviewed | family_closes_the_gap_development_only_clause_4_fails; Persistence distinguishes in the predicted direction (live 0.827 vs none 0.062), closing the structural gap Q1-002 named. Does NOT qualify the instrument: clause 4 of the charter completion condition fails because the family, its estimator and its statistics were authored while holding the specimen's ground truth - the same defect P15 recorded, and worse to repeat knowingly. Development case, not qualification. The naive adequacy statistic (shared-variance fraction) is a trap: it distinguishes in the WRONG direction, scoring the collapsed system 1.000 against the coordinated 0.586, because after collapse every subunit draws zero and residuals become identical - uniformity read as coordination. Caught only because the protocol froze both statistics and their predicted directions before implementation. | [q1_003_latent_shared_regressor](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_003_latent_shared_regressor.md); [q1_003_latent_shared_regressor_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_003_latent_shared_regressor_results.md) |
| Q1-002 | Is Q1-001's null caused by the authored observation contract, or by the candidate family? | result_reviewed | modelling_problem_not_packaging_problem; None of three observation contracts distinguishes the coordinated from the uncoordinated run at the disposition level. Rules out the cheap explanation for Q1-001: the coupling is not hidden by packaging, it is unrepresentable in repeated_entity_dynamics, which fits each entity under a shared local law. Contract B (attempted, served) was predicted most likely to succeed and was worst - it made the series less affine and the instrument abstained on both, showing legibility to an analyst and representability in a candidate family are different properties. Consequence: a shared packaging contract is worth building and will not buy coordination detection; those are two separate units of work. | [q1_002_observation_contract_variation](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_002_observation_contract_variation.md); [q1_002_observation_contract_variation_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_002_observation_contract_variation_results.md) |
| Q1-001 | Can the analytic instrument recover an authored coordination it was not told about, and not report it where it is absent? | result_reviewed | not_qualified_instrument_cannot_see_this_coordination; Same disposition for a coordinated and an uncoordinated run of the same system: shared_local_affine, candidate, passive_sufficient true on both. Worse than a tie - the instrument affirms passive sufficiency on a system whose behaviour is mediated by a shared quantity outside every entity. Clause 1 of the charter completion condition fails, so no construction claim in this programme is verified. Two positives: the proposal path accepted a fifth system it was not written for, confirming the case-specificity is in the packer not the proposer, and the vague open-endedness frontier is replaced by a specific gap - repeated_entity_dynamics has no candidate expressing dependence on an exogenous shared quantity. | [q1_001_instrument_qualification](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_001_instrument_qualification.md); [q1_001_instrument_qualification_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_001_instrument_qualification_results.md) |
| P15 | Can a modest type-directed proposal layer produce decision-relevant relational candidates or honest abstention across opaque archived systems without task labels? | result_reviewed | conditional_pass_seam_only_capability_claim_revised; Seam passes: both held cases (P13, P14) and, after correcting a P12 evaluator disposition-rule error, both development cases (P10, P12) matched native dispositions with all leakage/lineage/package checks passing. Capability claim relational_proposal_and_abstention is NOT established: its frozen operating condition 'no case-specific code paths' was violated on both sides of the freeze (four hand-written per-case proposers behind a dispatch, fed by four hand-written per-case packers that assign the dispatch key), and cross-case generality is measured at zero (12/12 refusals, 2026-09-04 probe). The held-system decision gate is therefore not cleanly earned; no discovery, generalization, or competence claim. | [p15_proposal_layer_benchmark](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/p15_proposal_layer_benchmark.md); [p15_proposal_layer_benchmark_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/p15_proposal_layer_benchmark_results.md) |

## composition

| Experiment | Question | Review | Outcome / disposition | Native evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| composition-exploration | Does categorical execution add practical value beyond validated Python without changing behavior? | result_reviewed | fidelity_pass_value_gate_failed; defer_production_runtime; retain_optional_prototype | [composition_exploration_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/composition_exploration_results.md) |
| C1-001 | Does a shared scarcity signal have to track scarcity, or does the best fixed threshold coordinate as well? | result_reviewed | conditional_pass_c1_supported_on_one_family_control_defect_recorded; All three frozen gates passed (G1 8/8, G2 8/8, G3 monotonic), and the conclusion survives a stronger control than the frozen one: adaptive 1.000 vs best fixed threshold 0.500. But the protocol's stated justification for its negative control is measured false - the frozen level (live time-average, ~0.51) sits below the 0.60-0.85 band where any constant works, so the recorded 0.000-to-1.000 effect size overstates. Restated effect: tracking roughly doubles satisfaction over the best constant. Constructive, authored, white-box, one family; not a discovery and not a claim about composition in general. | [c1_001_shared_scarcity_signal](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c1_001_shared_scarcity_signal.md); [c1_001_shared_scarcity_signal_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c1_001_shared_scarcity_signal_results.md) |
